snippet.title: Steel Bounty — MicroProse Publishing Announcement
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574290/Steel_Bounty

MicroProse Announces Steel Bounty

Steel Bounty is a new first-person mecha simulation focused on deep customization and mercenary company management. Lead your pilots, build and fine-tune powerful mechs, and fight from immersive cockpit views in fully destructible environments.

Steel Bounty is in early development, with more details to come.

#SteelBounty #MicroProse #Mecha #Simulation
